अर्धं वै पुरुषस्य निरृतिगृहीतम् अर्धम् अनिरृतिगृहीतं यन् निरृतिगृहीतं तद् एवास्मात् तेन निरवदयते पुनर् एत्यानुमत्या अष्टाकपालेन प्रचरन्ति निरृतिम् एव निरवदायेयं वा अनुमतिर् वाग् वय् अनुमतम् एवैनं सवम् आक्रमयत्य् अष्टाकपालो भवति गायत्री हीयं गायत्री वाग् धेनुर् दक्षिणैतद् ध्य् अनुमत्या रूपम् अथ य उदञ्चः शम्याम् अतिशीयन्ते तान् उदङ् परेत्य वल्मीकवपाम् उद्रुज्य जुहुयाद् इदम् अमुष्यामुष्यायणस्य क्षेत्रियम् अवयजा इति तत् पुनर् अपिदधातीदम् अहम् अमुष्यामुष्यायणस्य क्षेत्रियम् अपिदधामीति क्षेत्रियं वा एतं गृह्णाति ये चैनम् अन्व् इयं क्षेत्रस्य पत्न्य् अस्याम् एव क्षेत्रियम् अवयज्याथैनं सवम् आक्रमयति श्वो भूत आदित्येभ्यो भुवद्वद्भ्यो घृते चरुर् इत्य् आदित्या वा इत उत्तमाः स्वर्गं लोकम् आयंस् तेभ्य एव प्रोच्य स्वर्गं लोकम् एत्य् आदित्या वा अस्मिंल् लोक ऋद्धा आदित्या अमुष्मिन्न् उभयोर् एव लोकयोर् ऋध्नोति वरो दक्षिणा वरेणैव स्वर्गं लोकम् अभ्यारोहति श्वो भूत आग्नावैष्णव एकादशकपाला इत्य् अग्निर् वै सर्वा देवता विष्णुर् यज्ञो देवताश् चैव यज्ञं चालब्धाग्निर् वै यज्ञस्यान्तो ऽवस्ताद् विष्णुः परस्ताद् उभयत एव यज्ञस्यान्ता उदग्रहीद् उभयत एव यज्ञस्यान्ता उद्गृह्य यथोत्सङ्ग आवपेतैवं वा एतद् यज्ञम् आवपते तस्य यथाकामं निर्वपमाण एत्य् अनड्वान् वामनो दक्षिणा यद् वही तेनाग्नेयो यद् वामनस् तेन वैष्णवो रूपेणैवैनं समर्धयति श्वो भूते ऽग्नीषोमीया एकादशकपाला इत्य् अग्नीषोमाभ्यां वै वीर्येणेन्द्रो वृत्रम् अहन् वृत्रं खलु वा एष हन्ति यो राजसूयेनाभिषिञ्चते तद् वार्त्रघ्नम् एवैतद् धिरण्यं दक्षिणा सत्यं वै हिरण्यं सत्येनैव हन्ति श्वो भूत ऐन्द्राग्न एकादशकपाला इत्य् अग्नीषोमाभ्यां वै वीर्येणेन्द्रो वृत्रम् अहन् स ओजसा वीर्येण व्यार्ध्यत स एतम् ऐन्द्राग्नम् अपश्यत् तेनौजो वीर्यम् आत्मन्न् अधत्तौजसा वा एष वीर्येण व्यृध्यते यो राजसूयेनाभिषिञ्चत ओजो वीर्यम् इन्द्राग्नी ओजसैवैनं वीर्येण समर्धयतो ऽनड्वान् ऋषभो दक्षिणा यद् वही तेनाग्नेयो यन् मुष्करस् तेनैन्द्रो रूपेणैवैनं समर्धयति श्वो भूत आग्नेयो ऽष्टाकपालो माहेन्द्रं दधीत्य् ऋद्ध्या एवाग्नेय इन्द्रो वै वृत्रम् अहन् सो ऽन्यान् देवान् अत्यमन्यत स महेन्द्रो ऽभवत् स एतम् उद्धारम् उदहरद् वृत्रं हत्वा तद् उद्धार एवास्यैष भाग एव तस्माद् राजा संग्रामं जित्वोदाजम् उदजयत् पयसा वा एष वीर्येण व्यृध्यते यो राजसूयेनाभिषिञ्चते यत् पयः पयसैवैनं समर्धयतीन्द्रियेण वा एष वीर्येण व्यृध्यते यो राजसूयेनाभिषिञ्चते यद् ऐन्द्रम् इन्द्रियेणैवैनं वीर्येण समर्धयति देवताभिर् वा एष व्यृध्यते यो राजसूयेनाभिषिञ्चते सर्वदेवत्यं वै वासो यद् वासः क्षौमं दक्षिणा देवताभिर् एवैनं समर्धयति ॥
4.3.1.m:
Some indeed are hostile to a man, others are not.
Those who are hostile, that is Nirṛti;
those who are not hostile, that is Anumati.
For both of them together they apportion [the offerings].
Both together they boil.
With the one to Nirṛti they proceed first, having gone south to a natural cleft.
This indeed is the earth's part seized by Nirṛti.
In what is seized by Nirṛti he appeases Nirṛti.
Having laid down a single firebrand, he sacrifices with two stalks of creeper:
"May Nirṛti, enjoying [it], partake, svāhā!"
"A black garment with torn border is the sacrificial gift."
For this is the form of Nirṛti.
Half of man indeed is seized by Nirṛti,
half is not seized by Nirṛti.
What is seized by Nirṛti, that indeed he appeases away from him thereby.
Having returned, they proceed with Anumati's [cake] on eight potsherds,
having appeased Nirṛti.
This [earth] indeed is Anumati, or rather speech.
He makes him step into the consecration as permitted.
It is on eight potsherds,
for this [earth] is the gāyatrī, speech is the gāyatrī.
A milch cow is the sacrificial gift,
for this is the form of Anumati.
Now, those who fall beyond the yoke-pin to the north, having gone north, having torn open an anthill, he should sacrifice on them:
"I appease away this hereditary disease of so-and-so, son of so-and-so."
He covers it again:
"Here I cover the hereditary disease of so-and-so, son of so-and-so."
Hereditary disease indeed seizes this one, and those who [come] after him.
This [earth] is the mistress of the field.
Having appeased the hereditary disease away on her, he then makes him step into the consecration.
"On the next day, a caru in ghee for the Bhuvan-possessing Ādityas."
The Ādityas, going highest from here, went to the heavenly world.
Only having announced to them does he go to the heavenly world.
The Ādityas prosper in this world, the Ādityas in yonder [world].
He prospers in both worlds.
A chosen [boon] is the sacrificial gift;
by the chosen [boon] he ascends to the heavenly world.
"On the next day, a [cake] on eleven potsherds to Agni and Viṣṇu."
Agni is all the deities;
Viṣṇu is the sacrifice.
He has taken hold of both the deities and the sacrifice.
Agni is the sacrifice's end on this side;
Viṣṇu on the other side.
From both sides he has seized the ends of the sacrifice.
Just as one would gather into one's lap having seized from both sides the ends of the sacrifice,
even so does he gather the sacrifice.
Apportioning [offerings] according to his desire, he proceeds.
A dwarf ox is the sacrificial gift.
In that it carries [the yoke], thereby it belongs to Agni;
in that it is a dwarf, thereby it belongs to Viṣṇu.
By its form he makes him prosper.
"On the next day, a [cake] on eleven potsherds to Agni and Soma."
By Agni and Soma, by [their] manly power, Indra slew Vṛtra.
He indeed slays Vṛtra who is anointed by the Rājasūya.
This is a Vṛtra-slaying rite.
Gold is the sacrificial gift;
gold indeed is truth.
By truth he slays [him].
"On the next day, a [cake] on eleven potsherds to Indra and Agni."
By Agni and Soma, by [their] manly power, Indra slew Vṛtra.
He was deprived of force, of manly power.
He saw this [cake] for Indra and Agni.
Thereby he placed force and manly power in himself.
He indeed is deprived of force, of manly power, who is anointed by the Rājasūya.
Indra and Agni are force and manly power;
with force and with manly power they make him prosper.
A draft bull is the sacrificial gift.
In that it carries [the yoke], thereby it belongs to Agni;
in that it has testicles, thereby it belongs to Indra.
By its form he makes him prosper.
"On the next day, a [cake] on eight potsherds to Agni, and curds to Mahendra."
For prosperity is the one to Agni.
Indra slew Vṛtra.
He deemed himself superior to the other gods.
He became Mahendra.
Having slain Vṛtra, he took up this special portion.
That is his special portion;
that is his share.
Therefore a king, having won a battle, drives off the prize of victory.
He indeed is deprived of milk, of manly power, who is anointed by the Rājasūya.
Since there is milk,
with milk he makes him prosper.
He indeed is deprived of Indra's power, of manly power, who is anointed by the Rājasūya.
Since it belongs to Indra,
with Indra's power he makes him prosper.
He indeed is deprived of the deities who is anointed by the Rājasūya.
A garment belongs to all the deities.
Since a linen garment is the sacrificial gift,
he makes him prosper with the deities.

4.3.2.s: devā oṣadhīṣu pakvāsv ājim ayuḥ sa indro 'ved agnir vāvemāḥ prathama ujjeṣyatīti so 'bravīd yataro nau pūrva ujjayet tan nau saheti tā agnir udajayat tad indro 'nūdajayat tasmād aindrāgnam atho āhur āgnendraṃ kāryam ity agnir hi tā agra udajayat tad ujjityā evāgrāyaṇo dvādaśakapālo bhavati dvādaśa māsāḥ saṃvatsaraḥ saṃvatsarād dhi tad adhy abhavat saptadaśa sāmidhenīḥ kāryāḥ pañca ṛtavo dvādaśa māsā eṣa saṃvatsaraḥ saṃvatsarād dhi tad adhi bhavaty ekā vai tarhi yavasya muṣṭir āsīd ekā vrīher ekā māṣasyaikā tilasya tad viśve devā abruvan vayaṃ va etat prathayiṣyāmo bhāgo no 'stv iti tad viśve devā aprathayaṃs tad bhūmna eva vaiśvadevo 'tho prathayaty evaitena payasi syād vaiśvadevo vaiśvadevaṃ hi payo 'tha vā iyam abravīn mayi vā etad adhy asau vṛṣṭyā pacati naitad ito 'dhy ujjeṣyatha bhāgo nā astv iti tad ābhyāṃ vāvaiṣa bhāgaḥ kriyata ujjityay atho pratiṣṭhityā eva yad dyāvāpṛthivīyaḥ saumīr vā oṣadhayaḥ somā oṣadhīnām adhirājas tasya vā eṣa bhāgo yad akṛṣṭapacyaṃ tad uddhāra evāsyaiṣa bhāga eva tasmād rājā saṃgrāmaṃ jitvodājam udajate grāmyā vā anyā oṣadhaya āraṇyā anyās tā evāsyaitenobhayīr aveṣṭā bhavanti yāḥ phālakṛṣṭās tāsām etenāgrāyaṇaṃ karoti yā āraṇyās tāsām uttareṇānīto vā eṣa devānāṃ ya āhitāgnir yad akṛtvāgrāyaṇaṃ navasyāśnīyād devānāṃ bhāgaṃ pratikḷptam aśnīyād ārtim ārchet sarvebhyo vā eṣo 'nyebhyo 'bhiṣicyate yo rājasūya āgrāyaṇo 'nnādyasyāvaruddhyai vatsaḥ prathamajo dakṣiṇā reta iva hy eṣo 'prajātaḥ prajātyai ||
4.3.2.d: देवा ओषधीषु पक्वास्व् आजिम् अयुः स इन्द्रो ऽवेद् अग्निर् वावेमाः प्रथम उज्जेष्यतीति सो ऽब्रवीद् यतरो नौ पूर्व उज्जयेत् तन् नौ सहेति ता अग्निर् उदजयत् तद् इन्द्रो ऽनूदजयत् तस्माद् ऐन्द्राग्नम् अथो आहुर् आग्नेन्द्रं कार्यम् इत्य् अग्निर् हि ता अग्र उदजयत् तद् उज्जित्या एवाग्रायणो द्वादशकपालो भवति द्वादश मासाः संवत्सरः संवत्सराद् धि तद् अध्य् अभवत् सप्तदश सामिधेनीः कार्याः पञ्च ऋतवो द्वादश मासा एष संवत्सरः संवत्सराद् धि तद् अधि भवत्य् एका वै तर्हि यवस्य मुष्टिर् आसीद् एका व्रीहेर् एका माषस्यैका तिलस्य तद् विश्वे देवा अब्रुवन् वयं व एतत् प्रथयिष्यामो भागो नो ऽस्त्व् इति तद् विश्वे देवा अप्रथयंस् तद् भूम्न एव वैश्वदेवो ऽथो प्रथयत्य् एवैतेन पयसि स्याद् वैश्वदेवो वैश्वदेवं हि पयो ऽथ वा इयम् अब्रवीन् मयि वा एतद् अध्य् असौ वृष्ट्या पचति नैतद् इतो ऽध्य् उज्जेष्यथ भागो ना अस्त्व् इति तद् आभ्यां वावैष भागः क्रियत उज्जित्यय् अथो प्रतिष्ठित्या एव यद् द्यावापृथिवीयः सौमीर् वा ओषधयः सोमा ओषधीनाम् अधिराजस् तस्य वा एष भागो यद् अकृष्टपच्यं तद् उद्धार एवास्यैष भाग एव तस्माद् राजा संग्रामं जित्वोदाजम् उदजते ग्राम्या वा अन्या ओषधय आरण्या अन्यास् ता एवास्यैतेनोभयीर् अवेष्टा भवन्ति याः फालकृष्टास् तासाम् एतेनाग्रायणं करोति या आरण्यास् तासाम् उत्तरेणानीतो वा एष देवानां य आहिताग्निर् यद् अकृत्वाग्रायणं नवस्याश्नीयाद् देवानां भागं प्रतिकॢप्तम् अश्नीयाद् आर्तिम् आर्छेत् सर्वेभ्यो वा एषो ऽन्येभ्यो ऽभिषिच्यते यो राजसूय आग्रायणो ऽन्नाद्यस्यावरुद्ध्यै वत्सः प्रथमजो दक्षिणा रेत इव ह्य् एषो ऽप्रजातः प्रजात्यै ॥
4.3.2.m:
The gods ran a race when the plants had ripened.
Indra knew:
"Agni surely will win these first!"
He said:
"Whichever of us two wins first, that shall belong to us both together."
Agni won them.
Indra won them after [him].
Therefore [there is an offering] to Indra and Agni.
Now they say:
"It should be offered to Agni and Indra,
for Agni won them at the beginning."
That is just for victory.
The Āgrāyaṇa offering consists of twelve potsherds.
Twelve months are the year;
for from the year it came into being.
Seventeen kindling-verses are to be used.
Five seasons, twelve months: this is the year;
for from the year it comes into being.
There was indeed at that time a single fistful of barley, one of rice, one of beans, one of sesame.
Then the All-gods said:
"We will spread this out for you;
let there be a share for us!"
The All-gods spread it out.
Therefore the [offering] to the All-gods is for abundance;
and also one expands [it] by means of this.
The [offering] to the All-gods should be in milk,
for milk belongs to the All-gods.
Now she [the Earth] said:
"Upon me indeed that one ripens this with rain.
You shall not win [it] away from here;
let there be a share for both of us!"
Therefore this share is made for both of them,
for victory,
and also for a firm foundation,
in that there is one to Heaven and Earth.
The plants indeed belong to Soma;
Soma is the overlord of the plants.
His indeed is this share, which ripens without cultivation.
That is his chosen portion;
this is indeed [his] share.
Therefore a king, having won a battle, carries off the special spoil.
Some plants are cultivated, others are wild.
Both of these indeed become appeased for him by this.
With this he makes the Āgrāyaṇa offering of those which are cultivated by the plow; of the wild ones, with the subsequent one.
He who has established the fires has indeed been brought near to the gods.
If, without having performed the Āgrāyaṇa offering, he should eat of the new [grain], he would eat the allotted share of the gods; he would incur misfortune.
He who [performs] the Āgrāyaṇa offering at the Rājasūya is anointed above all the others,
for the winning of food.
A first-born calf is the sacrificial gift,
for he is like semen, not yet reproduced,
for procreation.

4.3.3.s: athaitāni cāturmāsyāni saṃvatsaraṃ vai cāturmāsyāni parījyante saṃvatsarād evaināny adhy āptvāvarunddha utsannayajño vā eṣa saṃvatsarād vā adhy utsannayajño 'varudhyate saṃvatsarād evainam adhy āptvāvarunddhe paśavo vā ete cāturmāsyebhyo 'dhy atiricyate yañ śunāsīryaṃ tān evāpnoti varṣya udake yajetaitad dhi paśūnāṃ nediṣṭham athaitāni pañca havīṃṣi saṃtatyai grāmakāmo yajeta vāyur vā imāḥ prajā nasyotā itthaṃ cetthaṃ ca nenīyate yad vāyave vāyur evāsmai nasyotāṃ viśaṃ ninayaty annakāmo yajeta saṃvatsaro vā indraḥ śunāsīraḥ saṃvatsaro 'nnādyasya pradātā tam eva bhāgadheyenopāsarat so 'smā annādyaṃ prayachati varṣya udake yajetaitad dhy annādyasya nediṣṭaṃ vṛṣṭikāmo yajeta vāyur vā ime samīrayati sa āpyāyayati tato varṣati saṃvatsaro vā indraḥ śunāsīraḥ saṃvatsaram anuvarṣati ||
4.3.3.d: अथैतानि चातुर्मास्यानि संवत्सरं वै चातुर्मास्यानि परीज्यन्ते संवत्सराद् एवैनान्य् अध्य् आप्त्वावरुन्द्ध उत्सन्नयज्ञो वा एष संवत्सराद् वा अध्य् उत्सन्नयज्ञो ऽवरुध्यते संवत्सराद् एवैनम् अध्य् आप्त्वावरुन्द्धे पशवो वा एते चातुर्मास्येभ्यो ऽध्य् अतिरिच्यते यञ् शुनासीर्यं तान् एवाप्नोति वर्ष्य उदके यजेतैतद् धि पशूनां नेदिष्ठम् अथैतानि पञ्च हवींषि संतत्यै ग्रामकामो यजेत वायुर् वा इमाः प्रजा नस्योता इत्थं चेत्थं च नेनीयते यद् वायवे वायुर् एवास्मै नस्योतां विशं निनयत्य् अन्नकामो यजेत संवत्सरो वा इन्द्रः शुनासीरः संवत्सरो ऽन्नाद्यस्य प्रदाता तम् एव भागधेयेनोपासरत् सो ऽस्मा अन्नाद्यं प्रयछति वर्ष्य उदके यजेतैतद् ध्य् अन्नाद्यस्य नेदिष्टं वृष्टिकामो यजेत वायुर् वा इमे समीरयति स आप्याययति ततो वर्षति संवत्सरो वा इन्द्रः शुनासीरः संवत्सरम् अनुवर्षति ॥
4.3.3.m:
Now these four-month sacrifices.
For a year the four-month sacrifices are performed.
Having attained them from the year, he wins them.
This is indeed a discontinued sacrifice.
From the year indeed a discontinued sacrifice is won.
Having attained it from the year, he wins it.
Cattle indeed are these which are left over from the four-month sacrifices,
namely the Śunāsīrīya.
He attains them.
He should sacrifice when there is rainwater,
for this is closest to cattle.
Now these five oblations
are for continuity.
One desirous of a village should sacrifice.
Vāyu indeed leads these creatures about this way and that, like [cattle] with pierced nostrils.
In that it is for Vāyu,
Vāyu brings to him the people like [cattle] with pierced nostrils.
One desirous of food should sacrifice.
The year is Indra Śunāsīra.
The year is the giver of food.
He approaches him with [his] share;
he gives food to him.
He should sacrifice when there is rainwater,
for this is closest to food.
One desirous of rain should sacrifice.
Vāyu drives these [clouds] together;
he makes [them] swell;
then it rains.
The year is Indra Śunāsīra;
it rains for a full year.

4.3.4.s: devāś ca vā asurāś cāspardhanta sa vṛtra indram abravīt tvaṃ devānāṃ śreṣṭho 'sy aham asurāṇāṃ saṃśaknavāva mā nā anyo 'nyaṃ vadhīd iti tau vai samāmetām anabhidrohāya te devā vṛtram amanyantāyaṃ vāvedaṃ bhaviṣyatīti ta indra aichan hanāmemam iti so 'bravīt saṃdhā vai me saṃhitān abhidrohāyeti tam agnir abravīd aham eva tvetaḥ pāsyāmīti pṛthivyā aham antarikṣād iti varuṇo 'haṃ diva iti rudras tato vai devā vṛtram aghnan vṛtraṃ khalu vā eṣa hanti yo rājasūyenābhiṣiñcate tad vārtraghnam evaitad devāś ca vā asurāś ca samayatanta tān agnis tredhātmānaṃ kṛtvā pratyayatata agnir evāsmiṃl loke bhūtvā varuṇo 'ntarikṣe rudro divi sa indro 'manyatāyaṃ vāvedaṃ bhaviṣyatīti so 'bravīd ahaṃ viśvābhyā āśābhyā iti tato vā ajayaṃs taj jityā evaitad etenaiva yājayet saṃgrāme jayati saṃgrāmam etenaiva yājayed bhrātṛvyavantaṃ yo vāsya priyaḥ syāt taṃ bhavaty ātmanā parāsya bhrātṛvyo bhavati yad vai tad indras turīya upasamapadyata tasmād indraturīyaṃ dhenur anaḍvāhī dakṣiṇā yad vahinī tenāgneyī yad dhenuḥ satī dāntā tena vāruṇī yad gaus tena raudrī yat payas tenaindrī rūpair evaināṃ samardhayatīndro vai namuciṃ nālabhata sa raśmīn kulāyaṃ kṛtvānvārohad amum ādityaṃ taṃ vā anvamantrayata sakhāyā asāveti so 'bravīn nāhaṃ haniṣyāmīti so 'bravīt saṃdhāṃ te saṃdadhai yathā tvā na divā hanāni na naktaṃ na śuṣkeṇa nārdreṇeti tasya vā upodaye sūryasya nīhāraṃ saṃtatyāpāṃ phenena śiro 'chinat tad vā enam anvavartata mitradrug asīti pāpmā vai namuceḥ śiraḥ pāpmā vā enaṃ tad anvavartata pāpmānaṃ vai sa tenāpāhata tat pāpmānam evaitenāpahate 'pāṃ nyayanād apāmārgān āharanty āpo vai rakṣoghnīr apo rakṣāṃsi na taranti rakṣasām apahatyai varo dakṣiṇā vareṇaiva varaṃ spṛṇoty ātmā hi vara ātmānaṃ hi tasya tad anvavartata ye devāḥ puraḥsado agninetrā rakṣohaṇas te no 'vantu te naḥ pāntu tebhyaḥ svāhety etaddevatyā vā imā diśo yathādevataṃ vā etad ābhyo digbhyo 'dhi rakṣāṃsy apahanty anuparikrāmaṃ juhoti sarvābhya eva digbhyo 'dhi rakṣāṃsy apahantīdam ahaṃ rakṣobhiḥ samūhāmy agne saṃdaha rakṣaḥ saṃdagdhaṃ rakṣā ity āha rakṣasāṃ dhvarāyai rakṣasām antarityay atha yat punaḥ samūhya juhoti yābhya eva digbhyo 'dhi rakṣāṃsy apāvadhīt tā bhāginīḥ karoty ahiṃsāyai rathaḥ pañcavāhī dakṣiṇā pañca diśaḥ pañca devatāḥ samṛddhyai ||
4.3.4.d: देवाश् च वा असुराश् चास्पर्धन्त स वृत्र इन्द्रम् अब्रवीत् त्वं देवानां श्रेष्ठो ऽस्य् अहम् असुराणां संशक्नवाव मा ना अन्यो ऽन्यं वधीद् इति तौ वै समामेताम् अनभिद्रोहाय ते देवा वृत्रम् अमन्यन्तायं वावेदं भविष्यतीति त इन्द्र ऐछन् हनामेमम् इति सो ऽब्रवीत् संधा वै मे संहितान् अभिद्रोहायेति तम् अग्निर् अब्रवीद् अहम् एव त्वेतः पास्यामीति पृथिव्या अहम् अन्तरिक्षाद् इति वरुणो ऽहं दिव इति रुद्रस् ततो वै देवा वृत्रम् अघ्नन् वृत्रं खलु वा एष हन्ति यो राजसूयेनाभिषिञ्चते तद् वार्त्रघ्नम् एवैतद् देवाश् च वा असुराश् च समयतन्त तान् अग्निस् त्रेधात्मानं कृत्वा प्रत्ययतत अग्निर् एवास्मिंल् लोके भूत्वा वरुणो ऽन्तरिक्षे रुद्रो दिवि स इन्द्रो ऽमन्यतायं वावेदं भविष्यतीति सो ऽब्रवीद् अहं विश्वाभ्या आशाभ्या इति ततो वा अजयंस् तज् जित्या एवैतद् एतेनैव याजयेत् संग्रामे जयति संग्रामम् एतेनैव याजयेद् भ्रातृव्यवन्तं यो वास्य प्रियः स्यात् तं भवत्य् आत्मना परास्य भ्रातृव्यो भवति यद् वै तद् इन्द्रस् तुरीय उपसमपद्यत तस्माद् इन्द्रतुरीयं धेनुर् अनड्वाही दक्षिणा यद् वहिनी तेनाग्नेयी यद् धेनुः सती दान्ता तेन वारुणी यद् गौस् तेन रौद्री यत् पयस् तेनैन्द्री रूपैर् एवैनां समर्धयतीन्द्रो वै नमुचिं नालभत स रश्मीन् कुलायं कृत्वान्वारोहद् अमुम् आदित्यं तं वा अन्वमन्त्रयत सखाया असावेति सो ऽब्रवीन् नाहं हनिष्यामीति सो ऽब्रवीत् संधां ते संदधै यथा त्वा न दिवा हनानि न नक्तं न शुष्केण नार्द्रेणेति तस्य वा उपोदये सूर्यस्य नीहारं संतत्यापां फेनेन शिरो ऽछिनत् तद् वा एनम् अन्ववर्तत मित्रद्रुग् असीति पाप्मा वै नमुचेः शिरः पाप्मा वा एनं तद् अन्ववर्तत पाप्मानं वै स तेनापाहत तत् पाप्मानम् एवैतेनापहते ऽपां न्ययनाद् अपामार्गान् आहरन्त्य् आपो वै रक्षोघ्नीर् अपो रक्षांसि न तरन्ति रक्षसाम् अपहत्यै वरो दक्षिणा वरेणैव वरं स्पृणोत्य् आत्मा हि वर आत्मानं हि तस्य तद् अन्ववर्तत ये देवाः पुरःसदो अग्निनेत्रा रक्षोहणस् ते नो ऽवन्तु ते नः पान्तु तेभ्यः स्वाहेत्य् एतद्देवत्या वा इमा दिशो यथादेवतं वा एतद् आभ्यो दिग्भ्यो ऽधि रक्षांस्य् अपहन्त्य् अनुपरिक्रामं जुहोति सर्वाभ्य एव दिग्भ्यो ऽधि रक्षांस्य् अपहन्तीदम् अहं रक्षोभिः समूहाम्य् अग्ने संदह रक्षः संदग्धं रक्षा इत्य् आह रक्षसां ध्वरायै रक्षसाम् अन्तरित्यय् अथ यत् पुनः समूह्य जुहोति याभ्य एव दिग्भ्यो ऽधि रक्षांस्य् अपावधीत् ता भागिनीः करोत्य् अहिंसायै रथः पञ्चवाही दक्षिणा पञ्च दिशः पञ्च देवताः समृद्ध्यै ॥
4.3.4.m:
The gods and the Asuras contended.
Vṛtra said to Indra:
"You are the best of the gods,
I of the Asuras.
Let us be capable [of an agreement];
let neither of us slay the other."
They two indeed swore for non-treachery.
Those gods thought of Vṛtra:
"This one surely will become this [all]!"
They desired of Indra:
"Let us slay this one!"
He said:
"An alliance indeed is bound by me for non-treachery."
Agni said to him:
"I indeed will protect you from here, from the earth."
"I from the atmosphere," [said] Varuṇa.
"I from the sky," [said] Rudra.
Then indeed the gods slew Vṛtra.
Vṛtra indeed he slays who is consecrated by the Rājasūya.
That indeed is this Vṛtra-slaying [rite].
The gods and the Asuras engaged in battle.
Having divided himself threefold, Agni braced himself against them,
having become Agni in this world, Varuṇa in the atmosphere, Rudra in the sky.
That Indra thought:
"This one surely will become this [all]!"
He said:
"I from all quarters."
Thence indeed they conquered.
That is just for victory.
With this very [rite] he should make one sacrifice in battle;
he wins the battle.
With this very [rite] he should make one sacrifice who has a rival, or him who might be dear to him;
he flourishes himself,
his rival falls away.
Because indeed Indra then attained a fourth share,
therefore it is the Indraturīya.
A milch draft-cow is the sacrificial gift.
In that she bears [the yoke], by that she belongs to Agni;
in that, being a milch cow, she is tamed, by that to Varuṇa;
in that she is a cow, by that to Rudra;
in that she has milk, by that to Indra.
With their proper forms indeed he makes her prosper.
Indra indeed could not overcome Namuci.
Having made the rays [of the sun] into a nest, he mounted up after yonder sun.
He indeed called after him:
"Let us two be friends!"
He said:
"I will not slay [you]."
He said:
"I will join an alliance with you so that I shall slay you neither by day nor by night, neither with dry nor with moist."
At the rising of the sun, having spread out a mist, he severed his head with the foam of the waters.
That indeed pursued him:
"You are a betrayer of a friend!"
Evil indeed was Namuci's head;
evil indeed then pursued him.
Evil indeed he struck away by that.
Evil indeed he strikes away by this.
From the descent-path of the waters they bring apāmārga plants.
The waters indeed are slayer of rakṣases;
the rakṣases do not cross the waters;
[it is] for the repelling of the rakṣases.
A choice boon is the sacrificial gift;
with a choice boon indeed he redeems a choice boon.
For the self is the choice boon;
for his self then pursued him.
"Those gods who, sitting in front, led by Agni, are slayers of rakṣases, may they favor us, may they protect us, to them svāhā!"
Belonging to these deities indeed are these quarters;
according to their deity indeed he strikes away the rakṣases from these quarters.
He sacrifices while walking around in order;
from all quarters indeed he strikes away the rakṣases.
"Here I sweep together with the rakṣases."
"O Agni, burn up the rakṣas!"
"Burned up is the rakṣas," he says,
for the overthrow of the rakṣases, for the destruction of the rakṣases.
Then, as to why he sacrifices having swept together again:
from whichever quarters he struck away the rakṣases, those he makes partakers of a share,
for non-injury.
A five-drawn chariot is the sacrificial gift;
five quarters, five deities,
for success.

4.3.5.s: somenejānaṃ yājayet saṃvatsaraṃ vā etasya chandāṃsi yātayāmāni bhavanti yaḥ somena yajate chandāṃsi vai devikāś chandāṃsi vāvāsmā etad ayātayāmāni punaryāmāṇi karoti rājasūyenābhiṣiṣicānaṃ yājayet paṣṭhauhī dakṣiṇāśāṃ vā eṣa upābhiṣiñcata āśā paṣṭhauhy āśām evāsmā akaḥ paśukāmaṃ yājayec chandāṃsi vai devikāḥ paśavaś chandāṃsi gāyatry anumatis triṣṭub rākā jagatī sinīvālī kuhūr anuṣṭub dhātā vaṣaṭkāro yā pūrvā paurṇamāsī sānumatir yottarā sā rākā yā pūrvāmāvāsyā sā sinīvālī yottarā sā kuhūś candramā eva dhātā yad dve avare dve pare tan mithunaṃ yat pūryate 'nyāṃ nānyāṃ tan mithunaṃ yat paśyanty anyāṃ nānyāṃ tan mithunaṃ yad amāvāsyāyā adhi candramāḥ prajāyate tan mithunaṃ tasmād evāsmai mithunāt paśūn prajanayati prajākāmaṃ yājayed dhātāram uttamaṃ kuryāt striyo vai devikāḥ pumān dhātā parācīr vai prajā reto dadhate parācīṣv evāsu reto dadhāti tad āhur na vai tena parādhatte yad antarā pravīyatā iti vyavadadhyād dhātāraṃ madhyataḥ sarvā evainā vṛṣamodinīḥ karoti tad āhur jāyata eva paścāccara iva tu bhavati strībhyo hy enaṃ paścāt pariṇayantīti sa yadā jāyetātha dhātre purastān nirvaped agraṃ vai dhātāgram evainaṃ pariṇayati ||
4.3.5.d: सोमेनेजानं याजयेत् संवत्सरं वा एतस्य छन्दांसि यातयामानि भवन्ति यः सोमेन यजते छन्दांसि वै देविकाश् छन्दांसि वावास्मा एतद् अयातयामानि पुनर्यामाणि करोति राजसूयेनाभिषिषिचानं याजयेत् पष्ठौही दक्षिणाशां वा एष उपाभिषिञ्चत आशा पष्ठौह्य् आशाम् एवास्मा अकः पशुकामं याजयेच् छन्दांसि वै देविकाः पशवश् छन्दांसि गायत्र्य् अनुमतिस् त्रिष्टुब् राका जगती सिनीवाली कुहूर् अनुष्टुब् धाता वषट्कारो या पूर्वा पौर्णमासी सानुमतिर् योत्तरा सा राका या पूर्वामावास्या सा सिनीवाली योत्तरा सा कुहूश् चन्द्रमा एव धाता यद् द्वे अवरे द्वे परे तन् मिथुनं यत् पूर्यते ऽन्यां नान्यां तन् मिथुनं यत् पश्यन्त्य् अन्यां नान्यां तन् मिथुनं यद् अमावास्याया अधि चन्द्रमाः प्रजायते तन् मिथुनं तस्माद् एवास्मै मिथुनात् पशून् प्रजनयति प्रजाकामं याजयेद् धातारम् उत्तमं कुर्यात् स्त्रियो वै देविकाः पुमान् धाता पराचीर् वै प्रजा रेतो दधते पराचीष्व् एवासु रेतो दधाति तद् आहुर् न वै तेन पराधत्ते यद् अन्तरा प्रवीयता इति व्यवदध्याद् धातारं मध्यतः सर्वा एवैना वृषमोदिनीः करोति तद् आहुर् जायत एव पश्चाच्चर इव तु भवति स्त्रीभ्यो ह्य् एनं पश्चात् परिणयन्तीति स यदा जायेताथ धात्रे पुरस्तान् निर्वपेद् अग्रं वै धाताग्रम् एवैनं परिणयति ॥
4.3.5.m:
He should make one sacrifice who has sacrificed with soma.
For a year indeed his meters become exhausted, [the one] who sacrifices with soma.
The meters indeed are the Devikās;
the meters surely he makes unexhausted for him, returning to course.
He should make one sacrifice who has been consecrated by the Rājasūya.
A four-year-old cow is the sacrificial gift.
To a quarter of the sky indeed this one is consecrated;
the four-year-old cow is a quarter of the sky;
he has provided a quarter of the sky for him.
He should make one sacrifice who is desirous of cattle.
The meters indeed are the Devikās;
cattle are the meters.
Anumati is the gāyatrī;
Rākā is the triṣṭubh;
Sinīvālī is the jagatī;
Kuhū is the anuṣṭubh;
Dhātṛ is the vaṣaṭ-call.
That full moon which is earlier, that is Anumati;
that which is later, that is Rākā.
That new moon which is earlier, that is Sinīvālī;
that which is later, that is Kuhū.
The moon indeed is Dhātṛ.
In that two are lower and two are higher, that is a pair.
In that one fills up and another not, that is a pair.
In that they see the one and not the other, that is a pair.
In that the moon is born from the new moon, that is a pair.
From that very pair he generates cattle for him.
He should make one sacrifice who is desirous of offspring.
He should place Dhātṛ last.
The Devikās indeed are females;
Dhātṛ is male.
Facing away indeed creatures take in semen;
in them, facing away, he places semen.
Concerning that they say:
"He does not place it facing away by that which is impregnated in between."
He should insert Dhātṛ in the middle;
all of them he makes rejoicing in the bull.
Concerning that they say:
"He is born indeed;
he becomes, however, as if walking behind,
for they lead him around from behind the women."
When he is born, then he should apportion [an offering] to Dhātṛ in front.
Dhātṛ indeed is the top;
he leads him around to the top.

He should make a sick man sacrifice.
He should place Dhātṛ in the middle.
The year indeed is Dhātṛ.
Bewildered indeed is his year;
therefore he is sick.
He has set the year right for him in the middle;
then he generates him from this pair.
These meters indeed are capable of wiping him out without a beast, unappeased.
A beast also is to be seized,
for appeasement, for non-wiping-out.
These indeed are cattle, namely rice and barley.
When there is a cake made of rice,
by that alone a beast is seized,
for appeasement, for non-wiping-out.
Some cattle abide in heroes; others do not abide in heroes.
Those whose cakes are in front abide in heroes;
those whose cakes are behind do not abide in heroes.
Those whose cakes are in front wait upon the one who enjoys [them],
for they were created towards Prajāpati as a foundation.
Those whose cakes are behind perish.
The pots in which there may be somas should be pap offerings.
Soma indeed is the placer of seed,
for procreation.
He should make him sacrifice who has sacrificed with all his possessions.
He indeed is deprived of cattle who gives everything.
Here indeed he sees cattle last where he distributes them;
from where he distributes them, from there he wins them back.
Whoever sacrifices with soma, him he should make sacrifice.
For a year indeed his meters become exhausted, [the one] who sacrifices with soma.
The meters indeed are the Devikās;
the meters surely he makes unexhausted for him, returning to course.

4.3.6.s: āmayāvinaṃ yājayed dhātāraṃ madhyataḥ kuryāt saṃvatsaro vai dhātā saṃvatsaro hi vā etasya mugdho 'thaitasyāmayati saṃvatsaraṃ vāvāsmā etan madhyato 'cīkḷpad athainam etasmān mithunāt prajanayatīśvarāṇi vā etam etāni chandāṃsy ṛte paśor aśāntāni nirmṛjaḥ paśur apy ālabhyaḥ śāntyā anirmārgāyaite vai paśavo yad vrīhayaś ca yavāś ca yad vrīhimayaḥ puroḍāśo bhavati tenaiva paśur ālabhyate śāntyā anirmārgāya vīrasthā vā anye paśavo 'vīrasthā anye ye purastātpuroḍāśās te vīrasthā ye paścātpuroḍāśās te 'vīrasthā ye purastātpuroḍāśā bhuñjatas ta upatiṣṭhante prajāpatiṃ hy ete pratiṣṭhām abhyasṛjyanta ye paścātpuroḍāśāḥ parā te bhavanti yāsu sthālīṣu somāḥ syus te caravaḥ syuḥ somo vai retodhāḥ prajananāya sarvavedasenejānaṃ yājayet paśubhir vā eṣa vyṛdhyate yaḥ sarvaṃ dadāty atra vā eṣa jaghanyaṃ paśūn paśyati yatrainān vibhajati yatraivainān vibhajati tata enān punar avarunddhe ya eva kaś ca somena yajeta taṃ yājayet saṃvatsaraṃ vā etasya chandāṃsi yātayāmāni bhavanti yaḥ somena yajate chandāṃsi vai devikāś chandāṃsi vāvāsmā etad ayātayāmāni punaryāmāṇi karoti ||
4.3.6.d: आमयाविनं याजयेद् धातारं मध्यतः कुर्यात् संवत्सरो वै धाता संवत्सरो हि वा एतस्य मुग्धो ऽथैतस्यामयति संवत्सरं वावास्मा एतन् मध्यतो ऽचीकॢपद् अथैनम् एतस्मान् मिथुनात् प्रजनयतीश्वराणि वा एतम् एतानि छन्दांस्य् ऋते पशोर् अशान्तानि निर्मृजः पशुर् अप्य् आलभ्यः शान्त्या अनिर्मार्गायैते वै पशवो यद् व्रीहयश् च यवाश् च यद् व्रीहिमयः पुरोडाशो भवति तेनैव पशुर् आलभ्यते शान्त्या अनिर्मार्गाय वीरस्था वा अन्ये पशवो ऽवीरस्था अन्ये ये पुरस्तात्पुरोडाशास् ते वीरस्था ये पश्चात्पुरोडाशास् ते ऽवीरस्था ये पुरस्तात्पुरोडाशा भुञ्जतस् त उपतिष्ठन्ते प्रजापतिं ह्य् एते प्रतिष्ठाम् अभ्यसृज्यन्त ये पश्चात्पुरोडाशाः परा ते भवन्ति यासु स्थालीषु सोमाः स्युस् ते चरवः स्युः सोमो वै रेतोधाः प्रजननाय सर्ववेदसेनेजानं याजयेत् पशुभिर् वा एष व्यृध्यते यः सर्वं ददात्य् अत्र वा एष जघन्यं पशून् पश्यति यत्रैनान् विभजति यत्रैवैनान् विभजति तत एनान् पुनर् अवरुन्द्धे य एव कश् च सोमेन यजेत तं याजयेत् संवत्सरं वा एतस्य छन्दांसि यातयामानि भवन्ति यः सोमेन यजते छन्दांसि वै देविकाश् छन्दांसि वावास्मा एतद् अयातयामानि पुनर्यामाणि करोति ॥

4.3.7.s: athaitat triṣaṃyuktaṃ yat pūrvaṃ triṣaṃyuktam ita evāsmai tenordhvān imāṃl lokān dādhāra yad uttaraṃ triṣaṃyuktam amuta evāsmai tenārvāca imāṃl lokān dādhāra tad eṣāṃ vāvaite lokānāṃ vidhṛtyai yat pūrvaṃ triṣaṃyuktaṃ vīrajananaṃ tad yad uttaraṃ paśujananaṃ tad yat pūrvaṃ triṣaṃyuktaṃ vīrān evāsmai tena janayati yad uttaraṃ paśūṃs tena yat pūrvaṃ triṣaṃyuktaṃ reta eva tena dadhāti yad uttaraṃ pra tena janayati yat pūrvaṃ triṣaṃyuktaṃ tena yajñakāmo yajetāgnir vai sarvā devatā viṣṇur yajño devatāś caiva yajñaṃ cālabdhaindro vai yajño viṣṇur yajñas tad yajñasyaivaiṣa ārambho 'tha yad vaiṣṇavo viṣṇur vai yajño yajña eva pratitiṣṭhati yad uttaraṃ triṣaṃyuktaṃ tena paśukāmo yajeta somo vai retodhāḥ pūṣā paśūnāṃ prajanayitā soma evāsmai reto dadhāti pūṣā paśūn prajanayatīndriyeṇa vai paśavaḥ prajāyante pūṣā prajanayatīndriyeṇaivāsmai pūṣā paśūn prajanayaty atha yat pauṣṇaḥ paśavo vai pūṣā paśuṣv eva pratitiṣṭhaty athaitad vaiśvānaravāruṇaṃ saṃvatsaro vā agnir vaiśvānaras tasya vā ete svā yad ṛtavas teṣāṃ vā eṣo 'bhiṣikto rājābhiṣikto vai devānāṃ varuṇa etau vai devānāṃ sūtav etau savapatī etau savasyeśāte tā enaṃ suvāte yāvanto vā etasya svā anukā vai ta etam anukā devā varuṇaṃ yāvanta evāsya svās tān asmā anukān avivādinaḥ karotīyāṃś carur bhavaty etāvān vā ātmā yāvān evāsyātmā taṃ varuṇān muktvā saṃvatsaro vā agnir vaiśvānaraḥ saṃvatsara evainaṃ pratiṣṭhāpayati saṃvatsarāyuṣam enaṃ karoti tasmād rājasūyābhiṣiktasya jarasā dantā avaśīyante saṃvatsare hy enaṃ pratiṣṭhāpayati saṃvatsarāyuṣam enaṃ karoti yo jyogāmayāvī syāt tam etena yājayed varuṇena hi vā eṣa pāpmanā gṛhīto 'thaitasya jyog āmayati yad vāruṇo varuṇād evainaṃ tena muñcatīyāṃś carur bhavaty etāvān vā ātmā yāvān evāsyātmā taṃ varuṇān muktvā saṃvatsaro vā agnir vaiśvānaraḥ saṃvatsara evainaṃ pratiṣṭhāpayati saṃvatsarāyuṣam enaṃ karoti ||
4.3.7.d: अथैतत् त्रिषंयुक्तं यत् पूर्वं त्रिषंयुक्तम् इत एवास्मै तेनोर्ध्वान् इमांल् लोकान् दाधार यद् उत्तरं त्रिषंयुक्तम् अमुत एवास्मै तेनार्वाच इमांल् लोकान् दाधार तद् एषां वावैते लोकानां विधृत्यै यत् पूर्वं त्रिषंयुक्तं वीरजननं तद् यद् उत्तरं पशुजननं तद् यत् पूर्वं त्रिषंयुक्तं वीरान् एवास्मै तेन जनयति यद् उत्तरं पशूंस् तेन यत् पूर्वं त्रिषंयुक्तं रेत एव तेन दधाति यद् उत्तरं प्र तेन जनयति यत् पूर्वं त्रिषंयुक्तं तेन यज्ञकामो यजेताग्निर् वै सर्वा देवता विष्णुर् यज्ञो देवताश् चैव यज्ञं चालब्धैन्द्रो वै यज्ञो विष्णुर् यज्ञस् तद् यज्ञस्यैवैष आरम्भो ऽथ यद् वैष्णवो विष्णुर् वै यज्ञो यज्ञ एव प्रतितिष्ठति यद् उत्तरं त्रिषंयुक्तं तेन पशुकामो यजेत सोमो वै रेतोधाः पूषा पशूनां प्रजनयिता सोम एवास्मै रेतो दधाति पूषा पशून् प्रजनयतीन्द्रियेण वै पशवः प्रजायन्ते पूषा प्रजनयतीन्द्रियेणैवास्मै पूषा पशून् प्रजनयत्य् अथ यत् पौष्णः पशवो वै पूषा पशुष्व् एव प्रतितिष्ठत्य् अथैतद् वैश्वानरवारुणं संवत्सरो वा अग्निर् वैश्वानरस् तस्य वा एते स्वा यद् ऋतवस् तेषां वा एषो ऽभिषिक्तो राजाभिषिक्तो वै देवानां वरुण एतौ वै देवानां सूतव् एतौ सवपती एतौ सवस्येशाते ता एनं सुवाते यावन्तो वा एतस्य स्वा अनुका वै त एतम् अनुका देवा वरुणं यावन्त एवास्य स्वास् तान् अस्मा अनुकान् अविवादिनः करोतीयांश् चरुर् भवत्य् एतावान् वा आत्मा यावान् एवास्यात्मा तं वरुणान् मुक्त्वा संवत्सरो वा अग्निर् वैश्वानरः संवत्सर एवैनं प्रतिष्ठापयति संवत्सरायुषम् एनं करोति तस्माद् राजसूयाभिषिक्तस्य जरसा दन्ता अवशीयन्ते संवत्सरे ह्य् एनं प्रतिष्ठापयति संवत्सरायुषम् एनं करोति यो ज्योगामयावी स्यात् तम् एतेन याजयेद् वरुणेन हि वा एष पाप्मना गृहीतो ऽथैतस्य ज्योग् आमयति यद् वारुणो वरुणाद् एवैनं तेन मुञ्चतीयांश् चरुर् भवत्य् एतावान् वा आत्मा यावान् एवास्यात्मा तं वरुणान् मुक्त्वा संवत्सरो वा अग्निर् वैश्वानरः संवत्सर एवैनं प्रतिष्ठापयति संवत्सरायुषम् एनं करोति ॥

4.3.8.s: athaite ratninaḥ kṣatrasya vā etāny aṅgāni yasya vā etāny ojasvīni bhavanti tad rāṣṭram ojasvī bhavati tāny evāsyaujasvīni karoti kṣatrasya vā etāny aṅgāni yasya vā etāni tejasvīni bhavanti tad rāṣṭraṃ tejasvī bhavati tāny evāsya brahmaṇā tejasvīni karoti bārhaspatyaś carur brahmaṇo gṛha iti brahma vai bṛhaspatir bṛhaspatipurohita khalu vai rāṣṭram ṛdhnoti brahma vā etat purastād rāṣṭrasyātyauhīd atho brahmaṇa eva rāṣṭram anukaṃ karoty aindra ekādaśakapālo rājño gṛha itīndriyaṃ vā indra indriya eva pratitiṣṭhaty ādityaś carur mahiṣyā gṛha itīyaṃ vā aditir asyā evainaṃ mātrāṃ gamayatīmām evainaṃ prajābhya upajīvanīyaṃ karoti dhenur dakṣiṇaitad dhy adityā rūpaṃ nairṛtaś carur nakhāvapūtānāṃ parivṛktyā gṛha iti nirṛtigṛhītā hi vā eṣāthaitāṃ parivṛñjanti nirṛtim eva niravadāyeyaṃ vā anumatir asyā evainaṃ mātrāṃ gamayatīmām evainaṃ prajābhya upajīvanīyaṃ karoti śyenī vaṇḍāpasphurā dakṣiṇaitad dhi nirṛtyā rūpam āgneyo 'ṣṭākapālaḥ senānyo gṛha ity agnir vai sarvā devatā devatābhir evāsya senāmukhaṃ jityai saṃśyati hiraṇyaṃ dakṣiṇā satyaṃ vai hiraṇyaṃ satyenaiva jayaty āśvino dvikapālaḥ saṃgrahītur gṛha iti rathareṣam evāsmāt tena niravadayate savatyau dakṣiṇeti savatyā iva hi savyasthasārathī ratham abhi sāvitro 'ṣṭākapālaḥ kṣattur gṛhe prasūtyay atho saviteva hy eṣa prajābhyaḥ prasuvati vāruṇo yavamayo daśakapālaḥ sūtasya gṛhe mārutaḥ saptakapālo vaiśyasya grāmaṇyo gṛha iti sūtamukhā vai viṭ kṣatram upatiṣṭhate sūtamukhāṃ vāvāsmā etad viśaṃ mukhato 'nnādyāyopadadhāti pauṣṇaś carur bhāgadughasya gṛha iti puṣṭir vai pūṣā puṣṭim evāsya bhāge dadhāti vaiṣṇavas trikapālas takṣarathakārayor gṛha iti viṣṇur vai yajño yajña eva pratitiṣṭhati raudro gāvīdhukaś carur akṣāvāpasya gṛhe govikartasya cety antata evāsmāt tena rudraṃ niravadayate 'tho rudra iva hy etau paśū abhimanyate ekādaśa vā etāni havīṃṣy ekādaśākṣarā triṣṭub vīryaṃ triṣṭub vīrya eva pratitiṣṭhati nānā vā eta eteṣām āśiṣo 'varundhate yat saha nirvapeyur aratninaḥ syur aindra ekādaśakapālo rājño gṛha itīndriyaṃ vā indra ekadhā vā etad yajamāne yajñasyāśīḥ pratitiṣṭhaty aindro hi yajamānaḥ ||
4.3.8.d: अथैते रत्निनः क्षत्रस्य वा एतान्य् अङ्गानि यस्य वा एतान्य् ओजस्वीनि भवन्ति तद् राष्ट्रम् ओजस्वी भवति तान्य् एवास्यौजस्वीनि करोति क्षत्रस्य वा एतान्य् अङ्गानि यस्य वा एतानि तेजस्वीनि भवन्ति तद् राष्ट्रं तेजस्वी भवति तान्य् एवास्य ब्रह्मणा तेजस्वीनि करोति बार्हस्पत्यश् चरुर् ब्रह्मणो गृह इति ब्रह्म वै बृहस्पतिर् बृहस्पतिपुरोहित खलु वै राष्ट्रम् ऋध्नोति ब्रह्म वा एतत् पुरस्ताद् राष्ट्रस्यात्यौहीद् अथो ब्रह्मण एव राष्ट्रम् अनुकं करोत्य् ऐन्द्र एकादशकपालो राज्ञो गृह इतीन्द्रियं वा इन्द्र इन्द्रिय एव प्रतितिष्ठत्य् आदित्यश् चरुर् महिष्या गृह इतीयं वा अदितिर् अस्या एवैनं मात्रां गमयतीमाम् एवैनं प्रजाभ्य उपजीवनीयं करोति धेनुर् दक्षिणैतद् ध्य् अदित्या रूपं नैरृतश् चरुर् नखावपूतानां परिवृक्त्या गृह इति निरृतिगृहीता हि वा एषाथैतां परिवृञ्जन्ति निरृतिम् एव निरवदायेयं वा अनुमतिर् अस्या एवैनं मात्रां गमयतीमाम् एवैनं प्रजाभ्य उपजीवनीयं करोति श्येनी वण्डापस्फुरा दक्षिणैतद् धि निरृत्या रूपम् आग्नेयो ऽष्टाकपालः सेनान्यो गृह इत्य् अग्निर् वै सर्वा देवता देवताभिर् एवास्य सेनामुखं जित्यै संश्यति हिरण्यं दक्षिणा सत्यं वै हिरण्यं सत्येनैव जयत्य् आश्विनो द्विकपालः संग्रहीतुर् गृह इति रथरेषम् एवास्मात् तेन निरवदयते सवत्यौ दक्षिणेति सवत्या इव हि सव्यस्थसारथी रथम् अभि सावित्रो ऽष्टाकपालः क्षत्तुर् गृहे प्रसूत्यय् अथो सवितेव ह्य् एष प्रजाभ्यः प्रसुवति वारुणो यवमयो दशकपालः सूतस्य गृहे मारुतः सप्तकपालो वैश्यस्य ग्रामण्यो गृह इति सूतमुखा वै विट् क्षत्रम् उपतिष्ठते सूतमुखां वावास्मा एतद् विशं मुखतो ऽन्नाद्यायोपदधाति पौष्णश् चरुर् भागदुघस्य गृह इति पुष्टिर् वै पूषा पुष्टिम् एवास्य भागे दधाति वैष्णवस् त्रिकपालस् तक्षरथकारयोर् गृह इति विष्णुर् वै यज्ञो यज्ञ एव प्रतितिष्ठति रौद्रो गावीधुकश् चरुर् अक्षावापस्य गृहे गोविकर्तस्य चेत्य् अन्तत एवास्मात् तेन रुद्रं निरवदयते ऽथो रुद्र इव ह्य् एतौ पशू अभिमन्यते एकादश वा एतानि हवींष्य् एकादशाक्षरा त्रिष्टुब् वीर्यं त्रिष्टुब् वीर्य एव प्रतितिष्ठति नाना वा एत एतेषाम् आशिषो ऽवरुन्धते यत् सह निर्वपेयुर् अरत्निनः स्युर् ऐन्द्र एकादशकपालो राज्ञो गृह इतीन्द्रियं वा इन्द्र एकधा वा एतद् यजमाने यज्ञस्याशीः प्रतितिष्ठत्य् ऐन्द्रो हि यजमानः ॥
4.3.8.m:
Now these ratnins.
These indeed are the limbs of the ruling power.
Of whomsoever these become full of vigor, his realm becomes full of vigor.
He makes them full of vigor for him.
These indeed are the limbs of the ruling power.
Of whomsoever these become full of fiery splendor, his realm becomes full of fiery splendor.
He makes them full of fiery splendor for him by the brahman.
"A mess of boiled rice for Bṛhaspati in the house of the Brahman-priest:"
Bṛhaspati indeed is the brahman.
Having Bṛhaspati as purohita, indeed, a realm prospers.
He has driven the brahman forward in front of the realm;
and also he makes the realm following the brahman.
"An eleven-pot-sherd [cake] for Indra in the house of the king:"
Indra indeed is power;
he establishes himself in power alone.
"A mess of boiled rice for Aditi in the house of the chief queen:"
This [earth] indeed is Aditi.
He makes him attain her measure.
He makes him one from whom subjects can gain a livelihood, just like this [earth].
A milch-cow is the sacrificial gift;
for this is the form of Aditi.
"A mess of boiled rice for Nirṛti, of grain winnowed by nails, in the house of the discarded wife:"
For she indeed is seized by Nirṛti;
therefore they cast her aside, having portioned out Nirṛti.
This [earth] indeed is Anumati.
He makes him attain her measure.
He makes him one from whom subjects can gain a livelihood, just like this [earth].
A white, tailless, kicking [cow] is the sacrificial gift;
for this indeed is the form of Nirṛti.
"An eight-pot-sherd [cake] for Agni in the house of the army-commander:"
Agni indeed is all deities.
By the deities indeed he whets the front of his army for victory.
Gold is the sacrificial gift.
Gold indeed is truth;
by truth alone he conquers.
"A two-pot-sherd [cake] for the Aśvins in the house of the charioteer:"
By it he portions out chariot-damage away from him.
"Two cows with calves are the sacrificial gift:"
For the warrior standing on the left and the charioteer are, as it were, two cows with calves toward the chariot.
An eight-pot-sherd [cake] for Savitṛ in the house of the distributor,
for impelling.
And also, like Savitṛ, this one impels for the subjects.
A ten-pot-sherd [cake] of barley for Varuṇa in the house of the court-bard.
A seven-pot-sherd [cake] for the Maruts in the house of the Vaiśya village-headman.
With the court-bard at its head, indeed, the clan attends upon the ruling power.
With the court-bard at its head he sets the clan in front for him for food.
"A mess of boiled rice for Pūṣan in the house of the tax-collector:"
Pūṣan indeed is nourishment;
he places nourishment in his portion.
"A three-pot-sherd [cake] for Viṣṇu in the house of the carpenter and chariot-maker:"
Viṣṇu indeed is the sacrifice;
he establishes himself in the sacrifice alone.
"A mess of wild-rice boiled grain for Rudra in the house of the dice-keeper and of the cow-slaughterer:"
At the end, by it, he portions out Rudra away from him.
And also, these two, like Rudra, threaten the cattle.
Eleven indeed are these oblations.
The triṣṭubh has eleven syllables.
The triṣṭubh is virility;
he establishes himself in virility alone.
Separately indeed they win the blessings of these.
If they were to offer [them] together, they would be without ratnins.
"An eleven-pot-sherd [cake] for Indra in the house of the king:"
Indra indeed is power.
Singly indeed the blessing of the sacrifice is established in the sacrificer;
for the sacrificer is of Indra's nature.

4.3.9.s: indrāyāṃhomucā ekādaśakapālaṃ nirvaped yad eva kiṃcārvācīnaṃ janitor enaḥ karoti tata enam aṃhomuṅ muñcatīndrāya sutrāmṇā ekādaśakapālaṃ ya evopavādī yo 'bhidāsati tata enaṃ sutrāmā trāyate 'thaitan maitrābārhaspatyaṃ satyaṃ vai mitro brahma bṛhaspatiḥ satyaṃ caiva brahma cālabhya dīkṣate kṣatraṃ vai mitro brahma bṛhaspatiḥ kṣatraṃ caiva brahma cālabhya dīkṣate yasya rāṣṭraṃ śithiram iva syāt tam etena yājayen maitrābārhaspatyena kṣatraṃ vai mitro brahma bṛhaspatir brahmaṇi vā etat kṣatraṃ pratiṣṭhāpayati draḍhimne 'śithiratvāyāthaite devasva ete vai devānāṃ sūtā ete savapataya ete savasyeśate ta enaṃ suvate tasmād vā etam āhuḥ pūrvedyur vā eṣa sūyate 'bhitaś ca sicyatā ity athaiṣa māruta ekaviṃśatikapālas trir vai saptasapta maruto viṇ maruto viśo vā etan madhyataḥ sūyate tasmād vā eṣa viśaḥ priyo viśo hi madhyataḥ sūyate varuṇasya vā abhiṣicyamānasyendriyaṃ vīryam apākrāmat tat tredhābhavad bhṛgus tṛtīyam abhavac chrāyantīyaṃ tṛtīyaṃ sarasvatīṃ tṛtīyaṃ prāviśad yad bhārgavo hotā bhavati śrāyantīyaṃ brahmasāmaṃ sārasvatīr āpas tad evendriyaṃ vīryaṃ teja āpnoti vācā vā etam abhiṣiñcanti yam abhiṣiñcanti vāk sarasvatī sārasvatīr āpo yat sārasvatībhiḥ sūyate yāvaty eva vāk tayā sūyate ||
4.3.9.d: इन्द्रायांहोमुचा एकादशकपालं निर्वपेद् यद् एव किंचार्वाचीनं जनितोर् एनः करोति तत एनम् अंहोमुङ् मुञ्चतीन्द्राय सुत्राम्णा एकादशकपालं य एवोपवादी यो ऽभिदासति तत एनं सुत्रामा त्रायते ऽथैतन् मैत्राबार्हस्पत्यं सत्यं वै मित्रो ब्रह्म बृहस्पतिः सत्यं चैव ब्रह्म चालभ्य दीक्षते क्षत्रं वै मित्रो ब्रह्म बृहस्पतिः क्षत्रं चैव ब्रह्म चालभ्य दीक्षते यस्य राष्ट्रं शिथिरम् इव स्यात् तम् एतेन याजयेन् मैत्राबार्हस्पत्येन क्षत्रं वै मित्रो ब्रह्म बृहस्पतिर् ब्रह्मणि वा एतत् क्षत्रं प्रतिष्ठापयति द्रढिम्ने ऽशिथिरत्वायाथैते देवस्व एते वै देवानां सूता एते सवपतय एते सवस्येशते त एनं सुवते तस्माद् वा एतम् आहुः पूर्वेद्युर् वा एष सूयते ऽभितश् च सिच्यता इत्य् अथैष मारुत एकविंशतिकपालस् त्रिर् वै सप्तसप्त मरुतो विण् मरुतो विशो वा एतन् मध्यतः सूयते तस्माद् वा एष विशः प्रियो विशो हि मध्यतः सूयते वरुणस्य वा अभिषिच्यमानस्येन्द्रियं वीर्यम् अपाक्रामत् तत् त्रेधाभवद् भृगुस् तृतीयम् अभवच् छ्रायन्तीयं तृतीयं सरस्वतीं तृतीयं प्राविशद् यद् भार्गवो होता भवति श्रायन्तीयं ब्रह्मसामं सारस्वतीर् आपस् तद् एवेन्द्रियं वीर्यं तेज आप्नोति वाचा वा एतम् अभिषिञ्चन्ति यम् अभिषिञ्चन्ति वाक् सरस्वती सारस्वतीर् आपो यत् सारस्वतीभिः सूयते यावत्य् एव वाक् तया सूयते ॥
4.3.9.m:
For Indra who frees from distress he should offer an eleven-pot-sherd [cake].
Whatever sin he commits this side of birth, from that he who frees from distress frees him.
For Indra the good protector [he should offer] an eleven-pot-sherd [cake].
Whoever is an accuser, whoever seeks to harm, from that the good protector protects him.
Now this [offering] to Mitra and Bṛhaspati.
Mitra indeed is truth;
Bṛhaspati is the brahman.
Having seized both truth and the brahman, he consecrates himself.
Mitra indeed is ruling power;
Bṛhaspati is the brahman.
Having seized both ruling power and the brahman, he consecrates himself.
Whose realm may be, as it were, slack, him he should cause to sacrifice with this [offering] to Mitra and Bṛhaspati.
Mitra indeed is ruling power;
Bṛhaspati is the brahman.
He establishes the ruling power in the brahman,
for firmness, for non-slackness.
Now these devasūs.
These indeed are the bards of the gods;
these are the lords of consecration;
these rule over the consecration;
they consecrate him.
Therefore indeed they say of him:
"On the preceding day indeed he is consecrated, and on both sides is he sprinkled."
Now this twenty-one-pot-sherd [cake] for the Maruts.
Three times indeed are the Maruts seven each.
The Maruts are the clan.
In the middle of the clan indeed he is consecrated.
Therefore indeed he is dear to the clan;
for he is consecrated in the middle of the clan.
From Varuṇa indeed, when being consecrated, his power and virility departed.
That became threefold:
Bhṛgu became one-third;
the Śrāyantīya [sāman] became one-third;
one-third entered Sarasvatī.
Because a descendant of Bhṛgu is the Hotṛ,
the Śrāyantīya is the Brahman's chant, and the waters belong to Sarasvatī,
that very power, virility, and fiery splendor he obtains.
With speech indeed they sprinkle him whom they sprinkle;
speech is Sarasvatī;
the waters belong to Sarasvatī.
Because he is consecrated with those belonging to Sarasvatī,
with as much as speech is, with that he is consecrated.

4.3.10.s: apāṃ vā etāni citrāṇy apāṃ vā etac citrāṇi saṃbharanty apām enaṃ citrair abhiṣiñcanti citram asmin dadhati tasmād vā eṣo 'bhiṣiktaś citraṃ rājeti śrūyate 'pāṃ hy enaṃ citrair abhiṣiñcanti citram asmin dadhati yathā vā idaṃ madhukṛto madhu saṃbharanty evaṃ vā etad apām oṣadhīnāṃ rasaṃ saṃbharanty apām enam oṣadhīnāṃ rasenābhiṣiñcanti rasam asmin dadhati tasmād vā etam āhur asī rājā puṇyā ity apāṃ hy enam oṣadhīnāṃ rasenābhiṣiñcanti rasam asmin dadhati varuṇasavo vā eṣa vāruṇīr āpo yad adbhir abhiṣiñcati varuṇam evainam akar viṣuvān vai sarasvatī sārasvatīr āpo yat sārasvatībhiḥ sūyate viṣuvān bhavati ṣoḍaśa grahā gṛhyante ṣoḍaśa homā hūyante tad dvātriṃśad dvātriṃśadakṣarānuṣṭub yāvaty eva vāk tayā sūyate ||
4.3.10.d: अपां वा एतानि चित्राण्य् अपां वा एतच् चित्राणि संभरन्त्य् अपाम् एनं चित्रैर् अभिषिञ्चन्ति चित्रम् अस्मिन् दधति तस्माद् वा एषो ऽभिषिक्तश् चित्रं राजेति श्रूयते ऽपां ह्य् एनं चित्रैर् अभिषिञ्चन्ति चित्रम् अस्मिन् दधति यथा वा इदं मधुकृतो मधु संभरन्त्य् एवं वा एतद् अपाम् ओषधीनां रसं संभरन्त्य् अपाम् एनम् ओषधीनां रसेनाभिषिञ्चन्ति रसम् अस्मिन् दधति तस्माद् वा एतम् आहुर् असी राजा पुण्या इत्य् अपां ह्य् एनम् ओषधीनां रसेनाभिषिञ्चन्ति रसम् अस्मिन् दधति वरुणसवो वा एष वारुणीर् आपो यद् अद्भिर् अभिषिञ्चति वरुणम् एवैनम् अकर् विषुवान् वै सरस्वती सारस्वतीर् आपो यत् सारस्वतीभिः सूयते विषुवान् भवति षोडश ग्रहा गृह्यन्ते षोडश होमा हूयन्ते तद् द्वात्रिंशद् द्वात्रिंशदक्षरानुष्टुब् यावत्य् एव वाक् तया सूयते ॥
4.3.10.m:
These indeed are the wondrous varieties of waters.
They collect the wondrous varieties of waters.
They sprinkle him with the wondrous varieties of waters;
they place wonder in him.
Therefore indeed, being consecrated, he is heard of as a "wondrous king";
for they sprinkle him with the wondrous varieties of waters;
they place wonder in him.
Just as here the honey-makers collect honey, even so indeed they collect the sap of waters and plants.
They sprinkle him with the sap of waters and plants;
they place sap in him.
Therefore indeed they say of him:
"You are a blessed king;"
for they sprinkle him with the sap of waters and plants;
they place sap in him.
A consecration of Varuṇa indeed is this.
The waters are of Varuṇa's nature.
When he sprinkles with waters,
he has made him Varuṇa.
The equinox indeed is Sarasvatī;
the waters belong to Sarasvatī.
Because he is consecrated with those belonging to Sarasvatī,
he becomes the equinox.
Sixteen cups are drawn; sixteen libations are poured;
that is thirty-two.
The anuṣṭubh has thirty-two syllables.
With as much as speech is, with that he is consecrated.

4.4.1.s: pratīpam anya ūrmir yudhyaty anvīpam anyo mithunatvāya yat tasya gṛhṇāti yaḥ pratīpaṃ yudhyaty ojasā vā eṣa vīryeṇa pratīpaṃ yudhyaty ojasā vā etad vīryeṇa rāṣṭra ojo vīryaṃ dadhāty atha yat tasya gṛhṇāti yo 'nvīpam īrayati māhiṣaṃ tena tokaṃ prajanayaty atha yan nadīpater apāṃ vā etan mithunam apāṃ vā etan mithunena rāṣṭre mithunaṃ dadhāty atha yad aprahāvarīṇāṃ madhyameṣṭheyaṃ tenāvarunddhe 'tha yat parivāhiṇīnāṃ pārevasyantyās tena tokaṃ prajanayaty atha yā āpo 'ñśerā ojasā vā etā vīryeṇāpo 'ñśerā ojasā vā etad vīryeṇa rāṣṭra ojo vīryaṃ dadhāty atha yat kūpyānām ubhayīs tenāpo 'varunddhe yāś ca samudriyā yāś cāsamudriyā īśvarā vā etam etā srotasyā āpo 'śāntā nirmṛjo yat sthāvarāṇāṃ gṛhṇāti śāntyā anirmārgāya yā ātapati varṣati yāś ca paridadṛśre tā āpo brahmavarcasyās tābhī rāṣṭre brahmavarcasaṃ dadhāty atha yad dhrādunīnāṃ viśas tena vīryam avarunddhe 'tha yat puṣpāṇām āraṇyaṃ tenātha yad ulbyānāṃ vajro vai paśavo vajrā ulbyā vajreṇa vā etad rāṣṭre vajraṃ dadhāty atha yat payasaḥ payasā vā etad rāṣṭre payo dadhāty atha yad ghṛtasyaitā vā āpo 'nādhṛṣyās tābhī rāṣṭram anādhṛṣyaṃ karoty atha yan madhor apāṃ vā eṣa oṣadhīnāṃ raso 'pāṃ vā etad oṣadhīnāṃ rasena rāṣṭre rasaṃ dadhāti ṣoḍaśa vā ete grahāḥ prājāpatyāḥ samānītaḥ saptadaśaḥ prajāpatiḥ saptadaśaḥ prajāpatim evāpnoti ||
4.4.1.d: प्रतीपम् अन्य ऊर्मिर् युध्यत्य् अन्वीपम् अन्यो मिथुनत्वाय यत् तस्य गृह्णाति यः प्रतीपं युध्यत्य् ओजसा वा एष वीर्येण प्रतीपं युध्यत्य् ओजसा वा एतद् वीर्येण राष्ट्र ओजो वीर्यं दधात्य् अथ यत् तस्य गृह्णाति यो ऽन्वीपम् ईरयति माहिषं तेन तोकं प्रजनयत्य् अथ यन् नदीपतेर् अपां वा एतन् मिथुनम् अपां वा एतन् मिथुनेन राष्ट्रे मिथुनं दधात्य् अथ यद् अप्रहावरीणां मध्यमेष्ठेयं तेनावरुन्द्धे ऽथ यत् परिवाहिणीनां पारेवस्यन्त्यास् तेन तोकं प्रजनयत्य् अथ या आपो ऽञ्शेरा ओजसा वा एता वीर्येणापो ऽञ्शेरा ओजसा वा एतद् वीर्येण राष्ट्र ओजो वीर्यं दधात्य् अथ यत् कूप्यानाम् उभयीस् तेनापो ऽवरुन्द्धे याश् च समुद्रिया याश् चासमुद्रिया ईश्वरा वा एतम् एता स्रोतस्या आपो ऽशान्ता निर्मृजो यत् स्थावराणां गृह्णाति शान्त्या अनिर्मार्गाय या आतपति वर्षति याश् च परिददृश्रे ता आपो ब्रह्मवर्चस्यास् ताभी राष्ट्रे ब्रह्मवर्चसं दधात्य् अथ यद् ध्रादुनीनां विशस् तेन वीर्यम् अवरुन्द्धे ऽथ यत् पुष्पाणाम् आरण्यं तेनाथ यद् उल्ब्यानां वज्रो वै पशवो वज्रा उल्ब्या वज्रेण वा एतद् राष्ट्रे वज्रं दधात्य् अथ यत् पयसः पयसा वा एतद् राष्ट्रे पयो दधात्य् अथ यद् घृतस्यैता वा आपो ऽनाधृष्यास् ताभी राष्ट्रम् अनाधृष्यं करोत्य् अथ यन् मधोर् अपां वा एष ओषधीनां रसो ऽपां वा एतद् ओषधीनां रसेन राष्ट्रे रसं दधाति षोडश वा एते ग्रहाः प्राजापत्याः समानीतः सप्तदशः प्रजापतिः सप्तदशः प्रजापतिम् एवाप्नोति ॥
4.4.1.m:
"One wave fights against the current, another with the current, for pairing."
In that he draws from that which fights against the current:
by vigor indeed, by heroic power, this one fights against the current.
By vigor indeed, by heroic power, he places vigor and heroic power in the realm.
Then in that he draws from that which drives with the current:
thereby he procreates buffalo offspring.
Then in that [he draws] from the lord of rivers:
that indeed is the pair of waters;
by the pair of waters indeed he places a pair in the realm.
Then in that [he draws] from the non-wandering ones:
thereby he obtains supremacy.
Then in that [he draws] from flowing waters:
thereby he procreates offspring for one who is about to cross over.
Then the waters that are calm: by vigor indeed, by heroic power are these waters calm;
by vigor indeed, by heroic power he places vigor and heroic power in the realm.
Then in that [he draws] from well-waters:
both kinds of waters does he thereby obtain,
both those belonging to the ocean and those not belonging to the ocean. These unappeased stream-waters are liable to sweep him away.
In that he draws from standing waters,
[it is] for appeasement, for not sweeping away.
Those waters that [fall when it] shines and rains, and which are seen around—those are endowed with brahman-splendor;
with them he places brahman-splendor in the realm.
Then in that [he draws] from hail-bearing [waters]:
thereby he obtains the heroic power of the people.
Then in that [he draws] from waters of flowers:
thereby [he obtains] the wild [animals].
Then in that [he draws] from waters of the amnion:
cattle indeed are a vajra;
the waters of the amnion are vajras;
by the vajra indeed he places a vajra in the realm.
Then in that [he draws] from milk:
by milk indeed he places milk in the realm.
Then in that [he draws] from clarified butter:
these waters indeed are unassailable;
with them he makes the realm unassailable.
Then in that [he draws] from honey:
this indeed is the sap of waters, of plants;
by the sap of waters and plants indeed he places sap in the realm.
Sixteen indeed are these cups belonging to Prajāpati;
brought together, it is the seventeenth;
Prajāpati is seventeenfold;
he attains Prajāpati himself.
